sentences.reason: The cited papers describe reusable skills or procedural memories and retrieval for later tasks.
LifeMem clusters workflow trajectories and recalls skills and trajectories with reduced forgetting.
TRIAGE offers exact reuse and parameter-substituted reuse of trajectory-based skills.
Paper 3 highlights memory representation and retrieval organization as key continual-learning design axes.
Paper 3 reports both stronger transfer from abstract procedures and forgetting in some retrieval designs.
MACE reports better retention and retrieval using linked functional units.
SWIFT transfers structural priors and demonstrations to generate workflows without iterative search.
